visual: Slender stems dancing with small white butterfly flowers for months
water: Regular at first · copes with short dry spells
soilWarning: Heavy winter wet is the killer
prune: Cut spent stems for more flowers · take old growth down in spring
hardinessNote: Hardy through most of the UK, approximately -10 to -5°C, where winter drainage is good.
resilience: Long-flowering and relatively drought tolerant once established
uses: Sunny borders · gravel and prairie planting · wildlife · pots
uncertain: Often labelled Gaura lindheimeri 'Papillon'; RHS also records Gaura 'Papillon' and Gaura lindheimeri 'Nugaupapil' as synonyms. (Oscar's note.)
latin: written in the deck's trade-name style, matching Oenothera lindheimeri GAUDI ROSE ('Florgaucomro') already in the deck.
peak: research said "Late spring to early autumn"; converted to May-Sep so the app can parse it.
